mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.magic_link_tokens (id, user_id, token, tenant_key, expires_at, resend_count, last_resend_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{token}, #{tenantKey}, #{expiresAt}, #{resendCount}, #{lastResendAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token, tenant_key, expires_at, resend_count, last_resend_at, created_at FROM public.magic_link_tokens WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND expires_at > NOW() ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
